notes.title: Patch 0.4.0 is now avalible!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hi Survivors! [/h1][p][b]Patch 4 is here![/b] We’ve reworked health, stamina, and armor into sleek new bars, rebalanced early-game zombies to be less punishing, and added long-requested features like a [b]continue button[/b], [b]day counter[/b], and crafting got a serious upgrade with categories and resource descriptions. And! [b]Artillery now makes its grand entrance early in the game.[/b][/p][p] On top of that, we tackled a huge list of bugs: [b]fixed infinite loadings, improved collisions, polished UI, rebalanced weapons, cleaned up co-op desyncs, and patched countless PoI softlocks.[/b] Oh, and [b]we killed off that big FPS drop when loading new parts of the world[/b] — your frames can finally breathe.
[/p][h3]More balance, more customization, smoother performance — welcome to Patch 4![/h3][p][/p][h3]🛡️ [b]Health, Stamina & Armor Bars[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The old icons retired and bars moved in. This gives us way more control over balancing — especially in the early game — and makes your survival stats easier to read at a glance.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🧟 [b]Zombie Balancing[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Early-game zombies are now less “[i]oops, you’re dead[/i]” and more “[i]heck yeah, I got this![/i]” Still dangerous, but way more fun to take down.[/p][/*][/list][h3]▶️ [b]Continue Button in Main Menu[/b][/h3][list][*][p]One button. One click. Back in the game. Simple, clean, finally here.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🛠️ [b]Custom Mode Upgrades[/b][/h3][p]More knobs and sliders to twist! You can now adjust:[/p][list][*][p]Zombie health[/p][/*][*][p]Zombie damage[/p][/*][*][p]Player damage [/p][/*][*][p]Resource gathering amount [/p][/*][*][p]Day/night cycle length [/p][/*][*][p]Increased zombie amount in the world[/p][/*][*][p]No roadblocks [img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f6a7.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]No night attacks [img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f319.png"][/img] ([i]now a checkbox, no more hiding in settings[/i])[/p][/*][*][p]All blueprints unlocked [img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f4d8.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Free building mode [img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f3d7-fe0f.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][h3]💣 [b]Artillery in Early Game[/b][/h3][list][*][p] We smoothed out the early-game flow so you get a taste of big booms right away. [img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f4a5.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][h3]🔔 [b]Interaction Notifications[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Small star effects now pop up when you interact with things — a little sparkle never hurts [img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/2728.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][h3]⏳ [b]Day Counter[/b][/h3][list][*][p] You can now see what day you’re on, right next to the clock. Survival journaling just got easier.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🧰 [b]Crafting Menu Overhaul[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Materials now have descriptions[/p][/*][*][p]Each description includes where to find them[/p][/*][*][p]Recipes are organized into categories ([i]no more endless scrolling![/i])[/p][/*][/list][h3]⚙️ [b]Machine Collision Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]We improved collision so it’s [b]much[/b] harder to trap yourself inside machines. Freedom restored.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🚀 [b]Optimization[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Removed a nasty FPS drop when loading new parts of the world. Your frames are safe again! [img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f680.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][h3]📈 Fixes & Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed trees and grids not loading correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Squashed several infinite loading bugs ([i]syntax input, joining games, Hong Kong region, etc.[/i]).[/p][/*][*][p]Cleaned up multiple null reference errors clogging logs.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized particle effects and smoke rendering for smoother visuals.[/p][/*][/list][h3]⚖️ Balancing & Gameplay[/h3][list][*][p]Adjusted zombie base HP from [b]50 → 40[/b] on Easy/Hard for fairer combat.[/p][/*][*][p]Rebalanced early fights so they’re less insta-death and more action-packed.[/p][/*][*][p]Weapon rebalance across the board for better feel.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Artillery and ballista properly introduced in early game flow.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Zombies do not attack destroyed core components anymore.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed boosted ranged attacks ([i]orange glow[/i]) not applying proper damage multipliers.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🕹️ UI & Controls[/h3][list][*][p]Continue button finally added to Main Menu.[/p][/*][*][p]New day counter next to the clock ([i]with “Day” label[/i]).[/p][/*][*][p]Small stars now appear for interactions ([i]and can be toggled off in options[/i]).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed stretched icons on blueprint popups.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected reversed/untranslated UI strings ([i]tooltips, sonar tab, blueprint unlocks, etc.[/i]).[/p][/*][*][p]Public/Private replaced with clearer Multiplayer labeling.[/p][/*][*][p]Stamina/Armor/Health now shown as bars ([i]with correct stamina warning icons[/i]).[/p][/*][/list][h3]🪓 Crafting & Resources[/h3][list][*][p]Crafting menu now has categories for easier browsing.[/p][/*][*][p]Materials now include descriptions + where to gather them.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed icons not displaying correctly on first open.[/p][/*][*][p]Added missing sound for birch tree falling.[/p][/*][*][p]Apple colliders fixed + proper placement in world.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🏗️ Machines & Building[/h3][list][*][p]Improved machine collision ([i]no more trapping yourself inside[/i]).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed collision issues on cockpits, chimneys, lights, mannequins, banners, and armor upgrades.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed storage desync between host/client.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed items disappearing when assigned to quickslots or storage menus.[/p][/*][*][p]Machines now update correctly after core component upgrades.[/p][/*][*][p]Various build mode fixes:[/p][list][*][p]Cannot place column-on-column exploits.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed floating stairs/platform issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed indestructible floor/roof pieces.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed removal of walls with lamps/decorations attached.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed building on higher floors being clunky.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]📜 POIs & Quests[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed quest markers ([i]e.g., sawmill blueprint flying outside rampart[/i]).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed BP missing on farm/workbench.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed softlocks and interaction issues on Oil Rig ([i]medium & hard[/i]).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Tesla Easy invisible rail.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Villa Renovation quest lock.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed “[i]Find blueprint[/i]” quest marker location.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed cannons launching players into the air.[/p][/*][*][p]Zombies no longer get stuck under the machine or attack destroyed cores.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues with zombie AI teleporting, flying, or falling through map.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🌐 Co-op & Networking[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed clients not loading properly after joining/kick.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed desyncs with health and storage.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed crashes when joining from lobby or after invite.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed turret/ballista behavior when a client is kicked mid-use.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed region lock/connection issues ([i]Hong Kong[/i]).[/p][/*][/list][h3]✨ Miscellaneous[/h3][list][*][p]Improved smoke & grass rendering.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed shaky camera when sprinting diagonally or standing on machines.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed jerky movement after toggling build menu quickly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed loss of items at end of storage list.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed tailoring menu appearing empty after switching tabs.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed “[i]/n[/i]” debug symbol showing in interaction text.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed overlapping materials (banner rods, windows).[/p][/*][*][p]Improved fan animations and decorative collisions.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Wrap Up![/h2][p]A huge thank you to all Survivors for your feedback on Steam and in reviews. Thanks also to everyone who used our Bug Reporter, which helped us quickly track down and squash the bugs that were hurting your gameplay experience! [/p][p]We haven’t said our last word yet, but these fixes should significantly improve your time with Survival Machine! Once again, thank you for being with us![/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/wZtvm9SqD8"]Come join us on our Discord[/url], where you can always meet someone from the dev team and chat about the game![/p][p]See you next time!

Dzięki![/p][p]Berdol

notes.title: Update 0.3.0 is live!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hi Survivors![/h1][p]
[h2]🎉 Our first Major Update is now live on Steam![/h2]

This marks another big milestone for us — and for you, it means a whole lot of fixes and improvements across the board!
We’ve touched on many aspects of the game, including further optimization tweaks, full gamepad support, the ability to change the UI keybinds, and of course... [b]the long-promised Tommy Gun![/b]

So what exactly is changing in Survival Machine starting today? Check out the full patch notes below! 👇
[hr][/hr]
[h3]🌟 Major Additions[/h3] [list][*] 📌 Improved early quest flow to visit a POI (Points of Interest) earlier.
[*] 🏗️ Changed costs on building elements to be more accessible.
[*]  🔒 Building menu will now show locked items.
[*]  🎮 Added full-gamepad support. [b]We reached GOLD![/b]
[*]  🎀 Added multiple nice decorations to build. Decorations now provide additional storage space on the Machine.
[*]  🔫 Added Tommy Gun, can be found in legendary chests after mid-game phase.
[*]  🖱️ Players can now change UI keybinds
[*]  🚀 Major optimization improvements
[/list]
[hr][/hr][h3]🧱 Collision & Environment Fixes[/h3]
[list][*]  Several cockpit assets (chairs, tables, railings, floors) have corrected collisions.
[*]  Walls can now be used for hanging objects on both sides without restrictions.
[*]  Corrected lack of collision on Factory platforms and Windmill platforms.
[*]  Fixed areas where players could fall through the map in Cemetery Medium and Oil Rig Easy.
[*]  Resolved issues with objects and terrain causing players to get stuck under or inside geometry.
[*]  Removed invisible collision barriers blocking player interaction at multiple POIs (Points of Interest).[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]🎮 Gameplay & Functional Fixes[/h3]
[list][*]  Fixed bug preventing players from starting a new game using Game Pad.
[*]  Players can place two roofs adjacent to each other where previously restricted.
[*]  Fixed active reload mechanic failing to work properly in co-op mode.
[*]  Addressed crafting bugs where clicking "Craft 5" would craft only once, and crafting would trigger outside valid UI bounds.
[*]  Fixed weapon shooting freeze and hotbar locking issues.
[*]  Fixed player getting stuck on ladders, platforms, and drivable vehicles.
[*]  Corrected issue where players could open certain chests from invalid positions or from underneath.
[*]  Resolved players stuck in the permanent options menu if the menu was open at death.
[*]  Fixed quest progression bugs including “destroy the zombie fort” marker visibility and “move the Machine” quest not completing.
[*]  Corrected issue where blueprints and autosaves overlapped causing game freezes.
[*]  Fixed problems with multiplayer hot join and item duplication blocking inventory and building[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]🖼️ Visual & UI Fixes[/h3] 
[list][*] Added proper glowing effects on all buildable objects.
[*]  Fixed misplaced UI elements such as task UI overlapping inventory UI and shifted build UI arrows.
[*]  Fixed language switching updating button labels correctly.
[*]  Added options to turn off automatic saves and improved control mapping responsiveness.[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]🚀 Performance & Stability[/h3]
[list][*]  Eliminated infinite loading screens on multiple save states.
[*]  Resolved crashes caused by overlapping autosave events and corrupted player files.
[*]  Fixed softlock issues on Factory and Oil Rig levels.
[*]  Corrected rotation and spawn position bugs on Oil Rig platforms.
[*]  Improved machine building synchronization between clients in multiplayer.
[*]  Fixed player model disappearing during skin changes at stations.[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]🌐 Localization & Accessibility[/h3]
[list][*] Corrected Polish translation errors (e.g., “kick” action).
[*]  Fixed several scattered UI text fragments in Japanese and Traditional Chinese.
[*]  Updated accessibility features including keybind changes and controller sensitivity splitting.[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]🧩 Miscellaneous[/h3][p] Removed offensive NPC name to respect all players.
 [list][*] Added day counter to the game HUD.
[*]  Fixed various POI-related bugs including hidden or invisible levers and disabled zipline usage after updates.
[*]  Improved build menu usability.
[*]  Fixed bugs where dropped items on machines were uninteractive.
[*]  Adjusted environment LOD transitions to prevent aggressive quality changes.
[*]  Fixed problems with quest task display on older save files.[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]👋 As always, we’re looking forward to hearing your feedback after the update![/h3]
We’ve done our best to make sure everything works as it should, but if you run into any issues or bugs, please let us know — either on [url=https://discord.gg/wZtvm9SqD8]our Discord[/url] or right here in the comments below. 

[b]Oh, and the bug reporter - use it in any case![/b] Don’t forget to write a few words about the issue you’re having in the text area - it helps us understand and find the bug much, much quicker! 

Thank you for being with us — your support and activity mean the world to the team!

[b]Have a great weekend, Survivors! [/b]
Dzięki 
Berdol

notes.title: Update 0.3.0 – All You Need to Know!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hi Survivors! [/h1][p]Today, I’d like to give you a little sneak peek of what we’ve been working on for Update 0.3.0, launching in just a week![/p][p]As always, we’ve put a lot of love and effort into this update, and we can’t wait to hear what you think about the new improvements coming to Survival Machine. Here's a quick look at what we've been up to in the past few weeks:[/p][list][*][p][b]🔧 Optimization – [/b]smoother and more stable gameplay[/p][/*][*][p][b] 🔫 Tommy Gun –[/b] a brand new weapon is coming your way! [/p][/*][*][p][b]🏗️  Building System – [/b]faster, more precise, and with new possibilities![/p][/*][*][p][b] 🎮 Gamepad Support & Auto-Aim – [/b]play your way, with enhanced aiming support[/p][/*][*][p][b] 🖱️  Customizable Controls in UI –  [/b]full key rebind options![/p][/*][/list][h2]
🔧 Optimization[/h2][p]We know this has been one of our bigger pain points, but also one of our top priorities. With the release of Update 0.3.0, you should notice a significant improvement in this area — we’ve put a lot of effort into it![/p][p]Alongside several smaller and larger changes, there’s one worth highlighting: starting with Update 0.3.0 , [b]the game will automatically suggest settings tailored to your PC’s capabilities[/b]. Of course, you're still free to manually adjust these settings if you prefer.[/p][p]However, we can’t move forward without you — we need your feedback on any issues you encounter. Update 0.3.0  definitely doesn’t mark the end of our optimization efforts, and the more input we get from you, the faster and more accurately we can keep improving![/p][p][/p][h2][b]🔫 [/b]Tommy Gun[/h2][p][b]We made a promise? We sure did! And now we’re delivering![/b][/p][p]A weapon ahead of its time — the pinnacle of military technology — is waiting for you just around the corner. A 20-round magazine and incredible rate of fire make it the perfect tool for taking on larger hordes of zombies. Few will be able to break through the wall of lead that Tommy unleashes.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/09bcaa6e9ca272f1bb110e38050122a1de9f8467.png"][/img][i]Pew pew pew pew!![/i][/p][p][b]You won’t be able to craft Tommy yourself at one of our workshops[/b] — to wield it, you’ll have to leave the safety of the Machine and head out to explore the world. Somewhere out there, hidden in one of the scattered crates, Tommy is waiting to be found.[/p][p]But fair warning — don’t go looking for Tommy right at the start of the game. We’ve planned for it to appear a bit later, as you progress through your journey.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]🏗️ Building System[/b][/h2][p]We had to take a step back and rethink the direction we want to take when it comes to building in our game. I'm talking about the vibe we want you to feel when constructing new structures and decorating your homes.[/p][p]It feels like it’s time to give this aspect a clearer, more defined direction — and that’s exactly what the upcoming changes in Update 0.3.0  aim to deliver.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/c0ce51c965ed09ed9e1058617cc3d96f67d170a7.png"][/img][i]Let there be light![/i][/p][h3]Decorations will be getting a theme[/h3][p]Survival Machine is all about the journey the player takes alongside their Machine. We wanted that theme to be reflected in our building system as well. That’s why we’re aiming for the new decorations to capture that same atmosphere.[/p][p]Our idea? Something along the lines of a traveler’s living workshop. What do you think?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/404ad554421e4e0b3d53a60081d82ccd674d88ab.png"][/img][i]The number of pipes needed to keep the Machine running is measured in miles — sometimes they even spill out from the deck![/i][/p][p]We want our decorative elements to fit well with the theme of the road that runs through our game. That’s why you’ll find trophies you’ve earned along the way, reminders of your journey.[/p][p]We also want to showcase the last remnants of luxury items humanity managed to create before the zombie apocalypse. And of course, there’ll be countless bits and pieces every traveler carries — things collected along the way that [i]might[/i] come in handy... someday.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/990f362b0ce7f9b38f747408f6f6c1331949b258.png"][/img][i]Your very own botanical garden[/i][/p][h3]Changes to the models[/h3][p]In addition to new features, we’ll also be making several improvements to things you’re already seeing in [i]Survival Machine[/i]. We’ve started reworking some of the models to better match the vibe I mentioned earlier. I won’t reveal all the details just yet, but take a look at the bed, for example. Before the changes, it looked like this:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/013fb888af242928439d005a0a930057afdd7761.png"][/img][/p][p]And after the changes, we’re proposing this look:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/1444f81d72cbf3b08bdf3fb7105d96dd515073ab.png"][/img][/p][p]What do you think?[/p][h3]Decorations increase storage[/h3][p]No, of course not all decorations will increase the item storage limit on the Machine. However, we felt that what currently serves as storage isn't sufficient — and not entirely logical either. After all, a wardrobe should have that function too, don’t you think?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/933f909656b53f64d3d07f95036b97cca5199412.png"][/img][i]No, the new wall clock won't increase your storage limit, but it looks pretty cool![/i][/p][h3]Building will be cheaper, and decorating less complicated![/h3][p]A lot of feedback was focused on this aspect. You mentioned that sometimes you don’t feel like hunting down recipes for decorations. We understand that, and we’d like to propose some changes here: while some of the best and most interesting decorative elements will still require finding recipes (so it doesn’t get too easy), we’ve significantly simplified the decoration process for your Machine.[/p][p]This way, everyone can quickly create a beast they can identify with, and more importantly — one that they enjoy building and traveling with to the last bastion of humanity.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]🎮 Gamepad Support & Auto-Aim[/b][/h2][p]In the previous update, we introduced the beta support for controllers. Based on your feedback, it seems that this control method is working well, and we haven’t received any major issues from you regarding its performance. And that’s great! [/p][p][b]With Update 0.3.0, we want to introduce an additional feature — auto-aim.[/b] Once again, just like with the controller support, we kindly ask for your feedback. Let us know how you think the auto-aim is working and where there’s room for improvement.[/p][p][b]Important note:[/b] if you’re not a fan of this feature, you can always turn it off by selecting the appropriate option in the settings.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]🖱️ Customizable Controls in UI [/b][/h2][p]Another important feature that many of you, especially left-handed players, have mentioned. With next week's patch, you will gain the ability to customize your key bindings to suit your individual needs. We hope this change will make your gaming experience more comfortable![/p][p]However, if any issues arise, please make sure to let us know — whether it's in the comments on Steam under this post or by [url="https://discord.gg/wZtvm9SqD8"]reaching out to us on our Discord[/url].[/p][p]We’d like to ask you to share your feedback on what accessibility options you think we should add. We’re aware that some players may have disabilities, so your input will be valuable in making the game more inclusive for everyone![/p][p][/p][h2]📦 [b]Wrap-Up[/b][/h2][p]That’s all for the sneak peek at [b]next week’s Update 0.3.0[/b]! We hope the changes we’re making will make the game more enjoyable for you. As always, we’re counting on your feedback – it means a lot to us![/p][p]Thanks for being with us, and we hope you have many fun and exciting evenings ahead with Survival Machine.[/p][p]Until next time! Dzięki![/p][p]Berdol

notes.title: Patch 0.2.0 is now available!
notes.notes: [h1][b]Hello Survivors![/b][/h1][p]Here comes Patch 0.2.0, which we’ve been working on over the past few weeks. It’s the result of your feedback and the needs you’ve so actively expressed in your reviews, discussions, and conversations on Discord. Thank you so much for your support and help with Survival Machine – without you, this patch wouldn’t be nearly as extensive! I hope the changes we’ve introduced will have a significant impact on how you experience Survival Machine and increase the enjoyment we want you to get from playing it. That’s enough of an introduction – let’s get into the details![/p][hr][/hr][h2]🚀 Highlights[/h2][list][*][p][b]Game-pad Support (Beta)[/b] - First iteration of game-pad support is live! Check the dedicated controller tab in Settings (we show Xbox tool-tips) and tell us how it feels. Auto-aim is planned for a future update.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Machine Collision Overhaul[/b] - Re-authored cockpit, ladder, pallet, front bumper, and railing colliders; prevents falling through, window-vaulting, and “air-walking” across the machine.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Crash & Infinite-Load Fixes[/b] - Addressed the top-reported crashes and added an on-screen message for rare infinite-load cases.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Performance Pass[/b] - Smarter render-distance swaps on quality presets, trimmed loading times, memory spikes, and GPU stalls on Low settings[/p][/*][*][p][b]Night Loot[/b] - Zombies now drop loot during nightly assaults, rewarding after-dark defence.[/p][/*][*][p][b]No Hard Game-Over[/b] - New Game-Lost flow: the night ends if all core components are destroyed—players must repair them before the machine can move on, but you can’t lose anymore.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Weakpoint Visuals[/b] - Destroyed weakpoints now switch to a broken model for clearer feedback and less confusion.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dynamic Music Blend[/b] - Re-tuned soundtrack logic for smoother transitions between Default, Combat, and POI themes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Siege Frequency Balance[/b] - On Adventure & Survival difficulties, zombie siege nights now occur every three nights by default.[/p][/*][*][p][b]POI Variety Boost[/b] - New randomisation rules greatly reduce how often the same POI appears in a single run.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]Detailed Patch Notes[/h2][hr][/hr][h3]🎮 Controls[/h3][list][*][p]Added full gamepad support with separate Xbox icons (beta). In the automatic setting, the game will detect whether you're using a gamepad or a mouse and keyboard. We've also left the option to choose mouse and keyboard only.[/p][p][img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//40709796/4cf779fa6400379eb2d65e6d8b4295b16df97e84.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a rare input lock when spamming ESC in the key-bind window while confirming changes.[/p][/*][*][p]“Load Game” now highlights the most recent save, not the oldest.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🏗️ Machine & Level Geometry[/h3][list][*][p]Cockpit interior, windows, and front plate now block players correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Patched gaps in ladders, railings, furnace walkway, bridge, and several POIs—no more sneaking into the void.[/p][/*][*][p]Wheels no longer spin in place after the Machine stops at a blockage.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed watermark plank collision on the bridge; fixed floating barrel after green dynamite[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🌍 World, Quests & Interaction[/h3][list][*][p]New games always start on the Stream map before rolling into random order as intended.[/p][/*][*][p]Zip-line: fixed an issue you drop early from the zip-line![/p][/*][*][p]Quest markers now clear correctly once the gate quest is finished.[/p][/*][*][p]“Player is full” tooltip shows only when you try to eat.[/p][/*][*][p]Added item sort-by-category and made Drop/Take-All respect that filter.[/p][/*][*][p]Weakpoints now swap to a destroyed mesh once broken.[/p][/*][*][p]Implemented new PoI randomization rules so locations repeat far less often.[/p][/*][*][p]Night Loot: zombies now drop loot during nightly assaults.[/p][/*][*][p]Game-Lost rework: the night ends if all core components are destroyed; players must repair them before the machine can move on—total game-over is gone.[/p][/*][*][p]Polish to the repair UI and new construction VFX.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🧟 AI & Enemies[/h3][list][*][p]Zombies no longer spawn or run mid-air; levitating hordes grounded.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed zombie pathing that let them climb machine ladders or breach secret gates unintentionally.[/p][/*][*][p]Zombie names are now synchronized for all players![/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where zombies could stop reacting to players after extended sessions.[/p][/*][*][p]Balanced pursuit logic—zombies no longer chase forever once line-of-sight is broken.[/p][/*][*][p]On Easy and Medium difficulties, siege nights now occur every three nights by default.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]📦 Multiplayer & Saves[/h3][list][*][p]Autosave stability greatly improved; fixed client inventory loss and wrong character loading. Let us know if the issue still persists![/p][/*][*][p]Lobby: Invite-Friend button now updates when privacy changes; Steam Overlay no longer appears in SP lobby.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed rare case where the client would spawn inside the starter house when loading a host-only save that skipped the tutorial.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved bug causing missing quests, workbenches, or upgrades after loading certain saves.[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed inventory lock that could occur when opening chests simultaneously in co-op.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🎨 Graphics & Audio[/h3][list][*][p]Restored missing textures in tunnels (Low) and on the optimization build.[/p][/*][*][p]Structures now play hit sounds when struck by zombies.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed assorted clipping banners, drapes, grass, and roof pieces.[/p][/*][*][p]Music blend improved – smoother transitions between combat and POI themes.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]⚙️ Optimization[/h3][list][*][p]Quality-preset swaps now override render distance properly.[/p][/*][*][p]General CPU/GPU tuning, fewer hitch-up spikes, faster level streaming.[/p][/*][*][p]Tackled heavy frame drops in co-op[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🛠️ Crash & Stability[/h3][list][*][p]Resolved several crash reports.[/p][/*][*][p]Added back-end protections around heavy-attack, zip-line use, and autosave triggers.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🐛 Bugs[/h3][list][*][p]We squashed 200 + issues across UI, AI, audio, animation, collision, and quest logic. If you still encounter a problem, [b]drop a report or screenshot[/b]—your findings help us keep Survival Machine rock-solid.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]Known Issues & Call for Feedback[/h2][list][*][p][b]Game-pad support is brand new, still a beta —tell us if a button feels off or a glyph is missing.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]We rebuilt dozens of colliders; if you still find spots to clip out of bounds, drop a screenshot in 🐛・bug-report on our Discord or use the in-game Bug Reporter tool (F2).[/p][/*][*][p]If crashes or infinite loads persist, send the in-game report or ping us on Discord with your log[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Thanks for surviving with us—see you on the rails! 👷‍♀️🛠️ Dzięki[/p][p][img src="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com//store_item_assets/steam/apps/1601330/header.jpg?t=1747221225"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Update on Recent Connectivity Problems
notes.notes:
[h3]Hi Survivors![/h3][p]We’ve seen the issues many of you experienced this past weekend when trying to play with friends. We know how frustrating it is to get disconnected mid-game, and [b]we want to sincerely apologize for that.[/b] Let us explain a bit about what’s going on.[/p][p]After quickly analyzing the nature of your reports — including how long you were playing, which countries you’re in, and whether similar issues occurred in other games in your region — we’ve concluded that the root of the problem lies with a network service provider that had outages in certain parts of the world.[/p][p]A particularly high number of [b]reports came from our players in Russia[/b]. Unfortunately, [b]there are currently network service issues in that region that are beyond our control, which may make co-op gameplay impossible.[/b] We encourage players from Russia to keep an eye on [url="https://discord.gg/wZtvm9SqD8"]announcements on Discord[/url] and Steam, where we’ll share any updates and next steps![/p][p]If you continue to experience this problem, please let us know by [b]using the bug reporter (F2 in-game) instead of leaving a Steam review[/b]. We’re all frustrated by the current situation. We need to wait and monitor whether the issue has been resolved and if players are no longer reporting this kind of problem.[/p][p][b]That said, we’re not giving up.[/b] We’re waiting for the provider to resolve the issue, and in the meantime, we’re back to work. Some really important updates are nearly finished, and I can’t wait to hear what you think once they go live!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1601330/Survival_Machine/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Patch 0.1.0 just landed!
notes.notes:
[h1]🛠️We're ready with our Patch 0.1.0!🛠️[/h1]

[h3]TL;DR: Patch 0.1.0 brings major fixes to achievements, inventory, quests, and zombie behavior. Improved tutorial saving, UI, and localization across multiple languages.[/h3]

We’re rolling out Patch 0.1.0, which addresses a ton of your feedback since launch — and there’s been a lot of it! I’m incredibly grateful for all your comments and suggestions — they’ve really helped us identify areas for improvement and take action. So, what do we have in store for you today?
[h3]Achievements & Tutorial[/h3]
[list][*] Achievements 28 Days and Practice Makes Progress should now trigger correctly for client players.
[*] The game can now be saved during the tutorial. If players leave during the tutorial, quests will reset but inventory will be preserved.[/list][h3]Gameplay Fixes & Improvements[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed several instances where quests were desynchronized between players.
[*] Improved hot-join behavior—joining players will now consistently spawn on the machine.
[*] Fixed an issue where the world sometimes failed to load properly with the machine path.
[*] Quests requiring Advanced Components will now display a hint: “Drive the machine further to find blueprint/components” if none are currently available.
[*] The game will no longer autosave after a game over.
[*] Fixed multiple causes of infinite loading and improved inventory/toolbar loading. Further fixes are in progress.
[*] Resolved issues where items could disappear from the hotbar or inventory. Further fixes are in progress.
[*] Fixed a case where reviving a teammate could block other actions.
[*] Fixed a rare bug where weapons could enter a locked state.
[*] Resolved an issue with artillery buffs not applying to splash damage correctly.[/list][h3]Zombies & Combat[/h3]
[list][*] Reduced the number of zombies around the Collapse Roadblock.
[*] Fixed a bug where zombies could float or spawn incorrectly.
[*] Zombies should no longer jump on top of each other.
[*] Fixed instances where zombies could pass through walls.
[*] Zombies should no longer be able to damage core components through solid structures.[/list][h3]UI & HUD[/h3]
[list][*] Improved animations on the quest panel in the HUD.
[*] Fixed an issue where questlines weren’t visible for some players.
[*] Tooltips now correctly update after changing keybinds.
[*] The mouse now functions properly on the game over screen.[/list][h3]Building & Environment[/h3][list][*] Players can now place doors next to traps on all sides.
[*] Generators can now be rotated and placed on floor tiles, above the deck level.
[*] Barrels will now correctly display all stored items, even when they exceed the available slots if the barrels were destroyed/removed.
[*] Fixed an issue where the elevator could push players to fall under the map.
[*] Furnace UI will now correctly reflect when it’s empty after a reload.[/list][h3]Localization[/h3]
[list][*] Improved Japanese font support—Kanji characters should now display properly. Feedback is welcome!
[*] Addressed some localization issues such as blurry or small text in:
- Brazilian Portuguese
- Korean
- Japanese
- Traditional Chinese
- Polish[/list]I know I’ve said this before, but I really want to emphasize it — [b]thank you for being so active here on Steam, whether it’s in discussions, reviews, or comments, and for all the support you’ve been giving us on [url=https://discord.gg/wZtvm9SqD8]Discord[/url].[/b] You’re amazing — thank you! And now I’ll leave you with Survival Machine — I’m really looking forward to hearing your feedback on this patch! Enjoy!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1601330/Survival_Machine/

notes.title: Hotfix 0.0.9
notes.notes:
[h1]Hi Survivors, welcome to Custom Mode![/h1]

[b]Yes, you heard that right – custom mode![/b] Starting today, every Survival Machine player will be able to tailor the gameplay to their own preferences. Decide how often and in what numbers zombies will attack your Machine at night. Adjust the number of zombies in our Points of Interest, or take control over the durability of your items! [b]You can find Custom Mode when you start or load a game in the lobby![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/463cb428a7a74bd264a8cc48c8bd12c3f3abc4ce.png[/img]
What exactly are you going be able to change? We have few options for you:
[list][*] [b]Days Between Zombie Attacks[/b] – Survivors can now choose how often zombie attacks occur: every day, every 2, 3. 4 or 5 days, [b]or not at all[/b]. The decision is yours! 
[*] [b]Zombie attacks size during the night[/b] - the night attack is too easy? Try 200%! You want the game to be a bit less challanging? 50% is an option for you!
[*] [b]Points of Interest Zombie Count[/b] - change the number of zombies you'll encounter at our Festival, Caravan Crash and Tent Camp point of interest
[*] [b]Core Components Damage Over Time[/b] - you decide whether the core components of the Machine will degrade over time or not at all
[*] [b]Machine Fuel Usage Multiplier[/b] -  take control of fuel consumption! Increase the multiplier to make the game more challenging with higher fuel usage, or lower it for a more forgiving experience.
[*] [b]Item Durability Loss[/b] - this was something you highlighted often in your feedback. We're now putting the durability system in your hands—tweak it, reduce it, or turn it off entirely![/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/0856bc4c4d23386cca254b46665d8ae3bb0275bf.png[/img]
We hope this update significantly improves your gameplay experience – from now on, you decide how the core mechanics work! Big thanks to everyone for your feedback and for pointing out the issues that mattered to you. Let us know what you think!

This isn’t the end of improvements in Survival Machine – what else would you like to see in custom mode? Is there a feature you didn’t find on our list but think is really important? Let us know in the comments or on [url=https://discord.gg/wZtvm9SqD8]our Discord[/url]! Thanks! See you soon!

Dzięki!
Berdol

notes.title: Hotfix 0.0.5
notes.notes:
[h3]TL;DR[/h3]
We fixed items disappearing from hotbar, some bugs, tweaked solo and adventure play.

[h2]Hi Survivors!
[/h2]
This time, I’m splitting this post into parts. In the first part, I want to share the issues you’ve reported that we’ve been working on. In the second part, I’ll talk more about the balance changes. Then something about the future. Ready? Machine fueled up? Great — let’s go!

[h3]Fixes & Improvements[/h3]
[list][*] [b]Attempted a fix for items disappearing from the hotbar[/b]!!!
[*] Reduced GPU usage in the Main Menu to improve performance.
[*] The game now starts with the framerate locked at 60 FPS by default; players can unlock it in the settings.
[*] Added a failsafe to prevent characters from getting stuck after dodging.
[*] Fixed issues with broken storage containers and furnaces not functioning properly.
[*] Improved reliability when loading items into storage chests.
[*] Fixed a bug where berries and other food items could disappear from the hotbar. Further improvements to this issue are coming shortly.
[*] Resolved an issue where save files were not being displayed correctly when using the Turkish language.
[*] Quality settings now also adjust draw distance for more accurate performance scaling.[/list]
[h3]Balance Changes[/h3]
[list][*] Adjusted loot in legendary chests to include greater variety and more rewarding drops.
[*] Decreased the durability of the Miner’s Pickaxe to improve tool progression.
[*] Made zombie attacks less intense for solo players to improve the solo experience.
[*] Lowered the difficulty of zombie attacks in Adventure mode.
[*] The dismantler is now unlocked by default and has reduced material costs, making it easier to access early in the game.[/list]
[h3]Next Patch[/h3]
[list][*] Improvements to roadblocks and saving the game during the roadblock quest.[/list]
Once again — I just have to say it — [b]thank you, Survivors, for all the feedback you've been sending our way![/b] We're doing our best to make sure Survival Machine brings you as much fun and as few issues as possible. We read all of your comments and are working hard on the problems you're encountering. Stay frosty, Survivors!

Dzięki!
Berdol

notes.title: Coop Demo Hotfix 1.0
notes.notes:
[h2]Hi Survivors! [/h2]

From your reviews, it seems that you really enjoyed our co-op demo! We're very happy to hear that, and thanks for all the reviews ([i]including the negative ones, there was a lot of great feedback in them![/i]).

We've prepared a few hotfixes for you today, but also... [b]a bit of new content![/b] What exactly is changing in Survival Machine? Take a look at this list!

[h3]What's new?[/h3]
[quote=author] Tesla is ready to be explored[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/f37b51c9d33174b39064eb96854aa40aa65d83c1.png[/img][/quote]
[list][*]We added new Point of Interest to the demo - Tesla. 
[*]Now you can build a Spike Trap to defend against zombies.[/list]
[quote=author]Spikes will help you defend your Machine! But remember: the Machine has to be fueled for the traps to work![img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/a3b0f298c62f5bf0302ea6f1b9aa2a28b66389c3.png[/img][/quote]
[h3]What has been fixed?[/h3][list]
[*] There was a Resolution instead of input option in the Input setting. There is no more.
[*] Some players couldn't interact with their inventory or pick up loot from zombies. The issue has been resolved.
[*] Opening Bug Reporter on launch caused coursor disappearing in Main Menu. We have fixed that.
[*] We removed Tool Damage Buff exploit that gave players too high damage on tools and weapons.
